review_scope: Read-only independent review; no GPU tests or dataset subset runs

blocking_findings.detail: archive_case requires official-final.json but suite writes only metrics.json; first completed endpoint cannot archive. Align exact evidence contract, not placeholder.

build_cache partial metadata offset can survive final partial->target rename; resume branch skips target-exists guard, creates absent partial via w+ with old offset, potentially replaces target with zero-prefix/zero bank. Require existing partial and absent target when offset>0, or explicitly adopt validated target; preserve inconsistent state.
quantized_cache with progress.offset>0 may create any missing arrays in w+ and skip their old prefix. Require all arrays present with correct dtype/shape or fail preserving artifacts.

resource_findings.detail: train starts wall clock before make_batches, which builds quantization; costs then adds quantization build_seconds to cold cache charge. Quantization work is included twice in cold_seconds. Exclude quantization setup from warm process timer or separate counters without double-add.

checked_contracts: VOC original 1-based inclusive boxes retained; predicted zero-based bounds converted before strict IoU>0.5, difficult matches ignored, duplicate detections false-positive, equal class averaging and eleven-point interpolation
SKU COCO tensors separately extract precision for maxDets100 and500, no dependence on hardcoded stats[0] for500
Memory mapped feature banks, selected batches only; no np.array(full_bank) eager materialization
epoch_plan exact cumulative image quota independent of method and handles train counts not divisible by100
Training teacher journal durable attempted/completed events, replayed queries not silently zero
Fixed final epoch100; no intermediate held-out test score used for checkpoint selection
Campaign methods baseline-first then Transport/Blank/Detail/Lowpass; optional view and seed repeats deferred
Source/identity/dataset manifest hashes, per-input SHA at snapshot and stat identity reuse; DONE only after endpoint checks

final_review.execution_limits: Independent CPU-only checks; no GPU execution or paper-method validation. Fixed shared GPU lock root now guarantees mutual exclusion for all job parents.
